title: D2-2b: Pressure–Flow Correction under Conflicting Constraints
question_prompt: An RO plant reports an RO feed/high-pressure-pump discharge pressure of 78 bar. Classify the state as normal, warning, or immediate shutdown according to the applicable site operating policy, and state the immediate action. The applicable policy defines 55-70 bar as normal, above 75 bar as warning, and 80 bar as HH/immediate shutdown.
